entities.summary: Rokoko building in berlin. location for special exhibitions by the stadtmuseum berlin on wide-ranging themes related to the history and culture of berlin. Originating c. 1762 CE. Ephraim-Palais is a art museum with roots in Europe, arising around 1762.
